whatIs: Fontshare is a typeface service from Indian Type Foundry. It offers professional-quality families you can download at no cost, with permission for personal and commercial use.
It's a good fit when you're looking for a typeface with character for a website, an app, or a brand and don't want to pay for a license.
uses: Choosing a font for a landing page's headings and downloading it to host in your project.
Defining the typography for a client's identity without adding license costs.
Trying several families with your own text before deciding which one to use in an interface.
caveats: Two licenses coexist: some families use the ITF Free Font License, which isn't open source, and others use the SIL Open Font License; check which one each family has.
Fonts under the ITF license have more restrictions than those under the OFL: check their terms before including them in a project you're going to distribute.
Check that the family includes the weights and styles you need before committing to it.
pricingNote: The fonts can be downloaded at no cost and used in personal and commercial projects.
idealFor: Web and brand design that needs good fonts without a paid license.
